feed_summary: Ransomware operators including Spikey Scorpius (aka Qilin) and Tarnished Scorpius (aka Inc) are exploiting PAN-OS vulnerability CVE-2026-0257. The post Threat Brief: Active Exploitation of PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257 (Updated October 19) appeared first on Unit 42 .
title: Threat Brief: Active Exploitation of PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257 (Updated October 19)
